# Workflow reference

> Every GitHub Actions workflow in `.github/workflows/` — its triggers, kill switch, repository variables and secrets — generated from the workflow files themselves.

How the workflows fit together (the tiers, the one required check, the autonomy posture) is explained in [CICD.md](../CICD.md). A **switch** is a `*_ENABLED` repository variable the workflow reads before it acts; turning one on is a guardrail change ([CICD.md](../CICD.md#turning-on-continuous-autonomy-deliberate)).

## Workflows

| Workflow | Name | Triggers | Switch | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
